description: Request-only: asks the owner to approve paying an existing order_id (or group_id, one request per checkout group) over x402 (payment:request). It does not sign or pay; the owner confirms the exact transfer in their trusted wallet + Passkey (no wallet: cannot complete). Direct Pay is not escrow. Status: webaz_approval_requests; an unknown or execution-only record is not paid, so the original order is recovered rather than paid again.
name: webaz_request_x402_payment
